description:
A research lab needs a visual search experiment built in PsychoPy Builder for an attention study. The paradigm:

Participants search for a target letter T among distractor letter L shapes. On each trial, a fixation cross appears (500ms), then a search array with varying set sizes (4, 8, 12, or 16 items). The target T is present on half the trials and absent on the other half. Participants press SPACE when they find the target and N when it is absent.

The experiment must include:
- A welcome/instructions screen explaining the task to participants
- A practice block of 8 trials with accuracy feedback after each trial (correct/incorrect)
- A break screen between practice and main blocks
- A main experimental block using a conditions file
- A thank-you/debrief screen at the end

Create the conditions file at:
  /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/visual_search_conditions.csv

The conditions file must have columns: set_size, target_present, corrAns
It should include all combinations of set sizes (4, 8, 12, 16) crossed with target presence (1=present, 0=absent), with corrAns being 'space' for target-present and 'n' for target-absent trials.

Save the experiment as:
  /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/visual_search_experiment.psyexp
